proposed_capability: Bind observed save titles and household rosters before existing oldest-lab or latest-played startup dispatch.
player_save_control_impact: Names describe identity. Existing lab provenance, current-run approval, exact-build calibration and player-first effects continue to govern dispatch.
expected_outcome: Oldest eligible save in the chosen household with the requested roster in dev. Newest by in-game recency in production, with no downgrade to a different save.
negative_tests: Ambiguous title or household, incomplete roster, process mismatch, stale or missing authorization, uncalibrated load and protected slot must not dispatch.
rollback_path: Revert the feature commits. No saves or game installations are edited by this source sprint.
unresolved_unknowns: Windows game-visible title-to-slot evidence, actual EA inventory readback and portrait-switch trial.
